summary: Design-only readiness plan for future read-only UI preview surfaces that will surface (a) Collection Synergy V2 milestones and (b) Affinity Phase 2 gift catalog. NO UI is implemented in this task. NO buttons. NO writes. NO runtime activation. The plan strictly enumerates future-only candidate screens, mandatory empty-states, accessibility constraints, Borea hidden handling, and the prerequisites that must be satisfied before any screen is implemented.

future_readonly_screen_candidates.purpose: Read-only preview of collection synergy categories + milestone thresholds + caps from CS2-A readiness plan and CS2-B preview resolver.
future_readonly_screen_candidates.data_source_future: /api/synergies/collection/preview (READ-ONLY, future, behind COLLECTION_SYNERGY_PREVIEW_ENABLED feature flag, default OFF).
future_readonly_screen_candidates.borea_handling: any greek_borea row must be hidden until Borea visibility unlocks; legacy borea / primordial_gaia permanently excluded.

future_readonly_screen_candidates.purpose: Read-only preview of the AF2-A 85-entry gift catalog + AF2-B economy/cap policy summary.
future_readonly_screen_candidates.data_source_future: /api/affinity/gifts (READ-ONLY, future, behind AFFINITY_PREVIEW_ENABLED feature flag, default OFF). NO spend endpoint.
future_readonly_screen_candidates.borea_handling: any greek_borea gift row must be hidden until Borea visibility unlocks.

future_readonly_screen_candidates.purpose: A new read-only tab on hero-detail.tsx that surfaces the hero's current affinity tier (always tier_0/acquaintance in this phase) + favored gift categories. NO spend. NO activation.
future_readonly_screen_candidates.data_source_future: /api/affinity/hero/<hero_id>/preview (READ-ONLY, future, behind AFFINITY_PREVIEW_ENABLED flag, default OFF).
future_readonly_screen_candidates.data_source_fallback_design_only: static read of AF2-A draft + AF2-B policy
future_readonly_screen_candidates.borea_handling: tab MUST be hidden when hero_id === 'greek_borea' until visibility unlocks; tab MUST 404 for legacy 'borea' / 'primordial_gaia'.

strict_no_buttons_global_policy.rationale: Any active button creates a write path that bypasses the runtime / feature-flag gate. Read-only screens MUST stay read-only until DB schema, anti-abuse validation, balance review, and feature flag activation are ALL ratified.

ui_data_sources_future.primary_source_phase2_apionly: auth-gated read-only endpoints behind preview feature flags
ui_data_sources_future.primary_source_phase3_player_data: auth-gated player_data endpoints — only after DB schema + migration approved + AFFINITY_GIFT_RUNTIME_ENABLED / COLLECTION_SYNERGY_BATTLE_ENABLED ratified.
ui_data_sources_future.no_client_trust_principle: Client MUST NEVER POST owned-hero counts or affinity points to compute synergies / tiers. Server is source of truth.
ui_data_sources_future.no_local_async_storage_for_progression: Progression state must NOT be persisted in AsyncStorage / SecureStore — server-side only.

borea_hidden_handling.rule: Every collection synergy preview row, affinity gift row, and hero detail affinity tab MUST consult the central Borea visibility resolver before rendering. If the hero id resolves to a hidden Borea variant, the row/tab MUST NOT render at all (silent hide, not 'locked' label).

fallback_empty_states.user_message_fallback: Preview temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

future_activation_prerequisites: Inert read-only preview endpoints implemented behind preview feature flags (default OFF).
Cap policy ratified (CS2: <=15 total / <=5 per category; AF2: <=6 PvP total / <=2 per source).
Cross-system stack audit (STACK-A) PASS with no live source.
Accessibility audit pass on iPhone 12/13/14 and Samsung Galaxy S21.
Borea hidden invariant unit-tested at the UI layer.
Rollback plan: toggling preview feature flag OFF must hide the screen without crashes.
recommended_next_tasks: UI-PREVIEW-B (hypothetical): implement inert read-only collection synergy preview screen (no buttons).
UI-PREVIEW-C (hypothetical): implement inert read-only affinity gift catalog preview screen (no buttons).
UI-PREVIEW-D (hypothetical): accessibility / a11y test pass on both screens.
